content.text: In countries where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital sellers face a unique infrastructure challenge. In Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, for instance, payment gateways that work seamlessly with local currencies and cryptocurrencies are nonexistent. This is where the concept of decentralized payment gateways comes in, allowing creators to bypass traditional payment platforms and connect directly with their customers. COREMERCH has been pioneering this approach, developing sovereign stacks that grant full control to digital sellers over their commerce infrastructure. In this breakdown, we'll explore the no-KYC payment gateways for digital sellers and how they can be deployed without Stripe.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

A no-KYC payment gateway is a payment processing infrastructure that enables digital sellers to collect payments without verifying the identity of their customers. This concept is crucial for creators operating in regions where traditional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. By leveraging decentralized payment gateways, sellers can unlock new revenue streams and expand their market reach without being bound by platform fees or restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC payment gateway relies on a combination of cloud services and blockchain technology. Cloudflare Pages and Google Apps Script are used for hosting and backend logic, respectively, while Supabase and Google Sheets serve as the order storage and management systems. Meanwhile, Cloudflare R2 and Google Drive are employed for file delivery. The infrastructure is powered by NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that enables automatic on-chain verification and conversion of cryptocurrency payments to USD.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The no-KYC payment gateway is designed for digital sellers operating in regions with restricted payment platforms. This includes creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and other countries where traditional payment gateways are unavailable or heavily restricted. COREMERCH's solutions cater to the unique needs of these sellers, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers them to take control of their payment processing and expand their market reach.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a no-KYC payment gateway include the following: hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage and management on Supabase or Google Sheets, file delivery on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, and automatic on-chain verification and conversion on NOWPayments. These components work together seamlessly to enable digital sellers to collect payments without relying on traditional payment platforms.
